**2B.2 Research Note: Srettha Thavisin in 2024**

I found no credible 2024 evidence that Srettha Thavisin initiated or expanded a war of choice, annexation, covert destabilization, or proxy conflict. The available record points the other way: Thailand repeatedly used ASEAN diplomacy, humanitarian access, and border coordination to contain the Myanmar crisis.

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Statement on the Escalation of Conflicts in Myanmar](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/asean-fm-statement-escalation-conflicts-myanmar?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e) | Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand | April 18, 2024 | https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/asean-fm-statement-escalation-conflicts-myanmar?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e | Thailand joined a regional call for immediate restraint, cessation of violence, and humanitarian access. This is direct evidence against initiating or prolonging cross-border conflict. | `2B.2`, `2B.1`, `1B.8` |
| [Thailand stresses the importance of upscaling humanitarian assistance along the Thai-Myanmar border at the Human Rights Council](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm010324-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683c) | Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand | March 4, 2024 | https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm010324-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683c | Thailand emphasized humanitarian assistance, dialogue, reconciliation, and a peaceful, stable Myanmar. That is incompatible with covert destabilization or proxy escalation as a preferred policy. | `2B.2`, `2B.1`, `1B.8` |
| [Special Envoy of ASEAN Chair on Myanmar welcomes successful pilot project of humanitarian initiative between Thailand and Myanmar during his meeting with Vice Minister for Foreign Affairs of Thailand](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm260324-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e) | Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand | March 26, 2024 | https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm260324-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e | Thailand advanced a cross-border humanitarian pilot with ASEAN and Red Cross involvement. This is practical crisis containment, not war expansion. | `2B.2`, `2B.1` |
| [Vice Foreign Minister Sihasak meets with Special Envoy of ASEAN Chair on Myanmar](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/pr210424-2) | Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand | April 24, 2024 | https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/pr210424-2 | Thailand and the ASEAN Chair’s Special Envoy stressed de-escalation, cessation of hostilities, and maintaining ASEAN centrality. That is the opposite of treating force as a tool of choice. | `2B.2`, `2B.1`, `1B.8` |
| [Deputy Foreign Minister and National Security delegation visit Mae Sot to receive the latest update on the Thailand-Myanmar border situation](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/dpmfm-dpmim-dm-nscsg-maesot-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683c) | Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand | April 23, 2024 | https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/dpmfm-dpmim-dm-nscsg-maesot-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683c | Thailand sent a high-level civilian-security team to coordinate and support local agencies at the border. That indicates containment and management, not escalation beyond defensive necessity. | `2B.2`, `2B.1`, `1B.8` |
| [Thailand working ‘relentlessly’ to solve Myanmar crisis - Srettha](https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2798697/thailand-working-relentlessly-to-solve-myanmar-crisis-srettha) | Bangkok Post, reporting Bloomberg News | May 24, 2024 | https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2798697/thailand-working-relentlessly-to-solve-myanmar-crisis-srettha | Srettha said Thailand was working to reduce spillover violence and end the Myanmar crisis. This supports a non-expansionary, de-escalatory posture. | `2B.2`, `2B.1`, `1B.8` |
| [Prime Minister holds bilateral talks with Bangladeshi Prime Minister during her trip to Thailand](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/pm-meets-with-pm-of-bangladesh-2024-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e) | Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand | April 26, 2024 | https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/pm-meets-with-pm-of-bangladesh-2024-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e | Thailand pursued trade, connectivity, tourism, customs cooperation, and humanitarian discussion on Myanmar/Rohingya issues through bilateral diplomacy. That is evidence of compromise and nonviolent statecraft. | `2B.2`, `2B.1` |

**Search gap**

- I found no credible 2024 evidence of Thailand under Srettha launching a war of choice, annexation effort, proxy conflict, or covert destabilization campaign.
- I also found no evidence that he justified such actions as beyond defensive necessity.
- The strongest available evidence is negative-by-absence plus repeated diplomacy: the public record consistently shows restraint, humanitarian engagement, and ASEAN-centered crisis management.
